format: html

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

```

```{r}
BreedingSites<-read.csv("./data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(BreedingSites)
print(paste0("The column names are ",
             paste(colnames(BreedingSites),collapse = ",")))
#summarise the data
glimpse(BreedingSites)

print(nrow(BreedingSites))
print(ncol(BreedingSites))
print(dim(BreedingSites))
```

We now move on to the data about the stopover locations and other migration sites

```{r}
Migratory<-read.csv("./data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(Migratory))
glimpse(Migratory)
print(paste0("There are ",nrow(Migratory)," rows and ",ncol(Migratory)," columns"))
glimpse(Migratory$Tag) #character
glimpse(Migratory$Birth) #integer
```


Now we filter the dataset to the relevant columns.

```{r}
BreedingSites<-read.csv("./data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
bird_breeding_selected <- BreedingSites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |> #select unique rows
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)

Migratory<-read.csv("./data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
bird_migration_selected<-Migratory |>
  select(Site,winterLongitude,winterLatitude,pslon,pslat,
         iblon,iblat,awestlon,awestlat)|>
  distinct()|>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude=winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude=winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude=pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude=pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude=iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude=iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude=awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude=awestlat
  )
gt(bird_migration_selected)

```

Now we filter the data frames
```{r}
bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site == "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)
bird_breeding_not_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_not_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_long_10 <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Breeding_Longitude > 10)

gt(bird_breeding_long_10)
```

We filter out Spain from the data as there is no post-Saharan stopover data in this location

```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <-bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site !="Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
Now we group the migration dataset and take the medians of the values 

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
```
We find the values for each site
```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)
```

Summary of migration dataset
```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Latitude=median(Stopover_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude=median(Stopover_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude=median(Iberian_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Iberain_Longitude=median(Iberian_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude=median(Westmost_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude=median(Westmost_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude=median(Winter_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude=median(Winter_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE)
    
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
#less tedious:
bird_migration_summary<-bird_migration_grouped|>summarise(across(matches("_Longitude|_Latitude"),median,na.rm=TRUE))
```


```{r}
combined_bird_data<-full_join(bird_breeding_exc,bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```


Now, convert data to long format
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

Reconstruct wide format
```{r}
gt(combined_bird_data)
combined_bird_wide<-combined_bird_piv |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from=Location_Type,
    names_prefix=Location_Type,
    names_sep="_"
  )
```
Revert back to wide format
```{r}
combined_bird_piv |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from=c("Location_Type"),
        names_glue="{Location_Type}_{.value}",
        values_from=c("Longitude","Latitude")
    )
```

Subset data into spring and autumn migration

```{r}
spring_data<-combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% c("Breeding","Stopover","Winter"))

autumn_data<-combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% c("Breeding","Iberian","Westmost","Winter"))
gt(spring_data)
gt(autumn_data)
```
Save files for practical
```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```
